name: Red Velvet Mini Flan with Fresh Fruit
description: Individual red velvet flan with a creamy caramel top, finished with dulce de leche and fresh berries.
longDescription: A delicate twist on a classic flan, featuring a moist red velvet cake base topped with a silky, slow-baked custard and a glossy caramel finish. Each mini is hand-piped with dulce de leche and crowned with fresh strawberries and blueberries, served on a doily for an elegant presentation. Perfect for celebrations, gifts, or whenever you want a dessert that looks as beautiful as it tastes.

name: Choco Flan Mini with Dulce de Leche & Fresh Fruit
description: Individual chocoflan drizzled with chocolate and dulce de leche, topped with fresh berries and crushed nuts.
longDescription: A personal-sized chocoflan with a rich chocolate cake base and a silky vanilla flan layer on top, finished with drizzles of chocolate and dulce de leche. Each one is crowned with fresh strawberries and blueberries and sprinkled with crushed nuts for a delicate crunch. A beautiful balance of deep chocolate, creamy custard, and bright fruit in every bite.

name: Chocolate & Dulce de Leche Mini Cheesecake
description: Individual cheesecake in a graham crust, topped with piped dulce de leche and a chocolate heart.
longDescription: A personal-sized cheesecake baked in a buttery graham cracker crust, with a smooth and creamy filling finished with rich piped dulce de leche around the edge. Each one is dusted with red sugar and crowned with a chocolate heart, making it as charming as it is delicious. Perfect for Valentine's Day, anniversaries, gift boxes, or any occasion that calls for a sweet, eye-catching treat.

name: Strawberry Cream Cheese Flan Cake with Fresh Fruit
description: 10" strawberry cream cake topped with cheese flan, caramel, chantilly cream, and fresh fruit.
longDescription: A showstopping 10" layered dessert featuring a soft strawberry cream cake base topped with a silky cheese flan and finished with a glossy caramel glaze. Crowned with a ring of fresh strawberries, blueberries, and blackberries around a swirl of chantilly cream, this cake is as stunning to present as it is to eat. Perfect centerpiece for birthdays, anniversaries, and special celebrations.

name: Carlota de Fresa
description: Individual no-bake strawberry carlota with layers of cookie and creamy strawberry filling, topped with chantilly cream and fresh strawberries.
longDescription: A classic Mexican-style carlota made with fresh strawberries, layered with soft cookies and a smooth, creamy strawberry filling for a light, chilled treat. Each cup is finished with a swirl of chantilly cream and a fresh strawberry slice. Refreshing, elegant, and perfect for parties, showers, or warm-weather gatherings.

name: Choco Flan Heart Mini with Dulce de Leche
description: Heart-shaped individual chocoflan with a chocolate cake base, silky flan top, and a dulce de leche swirl.
longDescription: A personal-sized heart-shaped chocoflan featuring a rich chocolate cake base topped with a silky vanilla flan layer and finished with a glossy caramel top and a dulce de leche swirl. Elegant, romantic, and easy to personalize for any occasion. Custom toppers available on request for baptisms, weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, Valentine's Day, and other special celebrations — just let us know your theme when ordering.

name: Gelatina de Fresa with Fresh Fruit
description: Individual layered strawberry gelatin with a creamy milk base, topped with chantilly cream, fresh strawberries, and blueberries.
longDescription: A beautiful two-layer gelatina featuring a vibrant strawberry top and a smooth, creamy milk base for a perfect balance of fruity and rich in every bite. Each one is finished with a swirl of chantilly cream and crowned with a glazed strawberry and fresh blueberries. Light, refreshing, and elegant — ideal for parties, baby showers, baptisms, and any celebration that calls for a colorful dessert table.

name: Gelatina de Fresa con Crema
description: Individual layered strawberry and cream gelatina in clear cups, finished with chantilly cream and custom themed toppers.
longDescription: A beautiful three-layer gelatina with a bright strawberry base, a soft pink milk middle, and a creamy white top, served in individual clear cups to show off the layers. Each one is finished with a swirl of chantilly cream and easily customized with themed toppers. Perfect for baby showers, gender reveals, birthdays, quinceañeras, and any celebration that calls for an elegant dessert table. Custom toppers available on request, just let us know your theme when ordering.

name: Gelatina Mosaico de Fresas con 3 Leches
description: Individual mosaic gelatina with pink strawberry cubes suspended in a creamy tres leches base, finished with chantilly cream and edible decorations.
longDescription: A beautiful mosaic-style gelatina featuring jewel-like pink strawberry gelatin cubes suspended in a rich, creamy tres leches base. Each individual portion is molded for an elegant shape and finished with a swirl of chantilly cream and a delicate edible butterfly or floral topper. The combination of fruity gelatin and silky tres leches creates a soft, refreshing bite that feels both classic and special. Perfect for baby showers, bridal showers, quinceañeras, baptisms, and any celebration that deserves a dessert as pretty as it is delicious. Custom toppers available on request, just let us know your theme when ordering.

name: Gelatina Mosaico de Mora con 3 Leches
description: Individual mosaic gelatina with blue blackberry cubes suspended in a creamy tres leches base, finished with chantilly cream and themed toppers.
longDescription: A beautiful mosaic-style gelatina featuring jewel-like blackberry gelatin cubes suspended in a rich, creamy tres leches base. Each individual portion is molded for an elegant shape and finished with a swirl of chantilly cream, a sprinkle of sugar pearls, and a custom themed topper. The combination of fruity gelatin and silky tres leches creates a soft, refreshing bite that feels both classic and special. Perfect for baptisms, baby showers, first communions, gender reveals, and any celebration that deserves a dessert as pretty as it is delicious. Custom toppers available on request, just let us know your theme when ordering.

name: Flan de Fresa with Chantilly Cream and Fresh Fruit
description: Individual strawberry cake topped with silky vanilla flan, finished with chantilly cream and fresh berries or custom toppers.
longDescription: A personal-sized two-layer dessert featuring a soft, moist strawberry cake base topped with a silky vanilla flan and a touch of caramel. Each one is finished with a swirl of chantilly cream and crowned with fresh strawberries, blueberries, and blackberries, or customized with themed toppers for special occasions. The combination of fluffy strawberry cake and creamy flan creates a soft, balanced bite that feels both indulgent and refreshing. Perfect for baby showers, gender reveals, baptisms, birthdays, and any celebration that calls for an elegant individual dessert. Custom toppers available on request, just let us know your theme when ordering.

name: Gelatina Mosaico Patriotic Edition
description: Individual red, white, and blue mosaic gelatina with creamy tres leches, finished with chantilly cream and themed toppers.
longDescription: A festive seasonal version of our mosaic gelatina featuring red and blue gelatin cubes suspended in a rich, creamy tres leches base. Available in individual molded portions or layered clear cups to show off the colors. Each one is finished with a swirl of chantilly cream, patriotic sugar sprinkles, and themed toppers. Perfect for 4th of July cookouts, Memorial Day, Labor Day, military homecomings, and any patriotic celebration that calls for a colorful, festive dessert table.

name: Carlota de Durazno con Queso Crema
description: Individual no-bake peach and cream cheese carlota with layers of cookie, finished with chantilly cream, a peach slice, and a cherry.
longDescription: A creamy no-bake carlota made with sweet peaches and cream cheese, layered with soft cookies for a smooth, chilled treat in every cup. Each one is finished with a swirl of chantilly cream and topped with a glazed peach slice and a maraschino cherry. Light, refreshing, and elegant. Perfect for parties, showers, baptisms, and any celebration that calls for a beautiful dessert table.

name: Gelatina Mosaico de Uva con Crema
description: Individual mosaic gelatina with rich grape cubes suspended in a sweet, creamy milk base, finished with chantilly cream and a fresh blackberry.
longDescription: A beautiful mosaic-style gelatina featuring jewel-like grape gelatin cubes suspended in a smooth, sweet, creamy milk base. Available in molded individual portions or layered clear cups to show off the contrast. Each one is finished with a swirl of chantilly cream and topped with a fresh blackberry. The combination of bold grape flavor and rich, creamy gelatin creates a soft, indulgent bite that feels both classic and elegant. Perfect for parties, showers, baptisms, birthdays, and any celebration that calls for a beautiful dessert table.

name: Gelatina de Uva con Crema
description: Individual two-layer molded gelatina with a glossy grape top and a sweet, creamy milk base, finished with chantilly cream and a fresh blackberry.
longDescription: A beautiful two-layer gelatina featuring a deep, glossy grape layer molded over a smooth, sweet, creamy milk base. Each one is shaped in an elegant flower-style mold, then finished with a swirl of chantilly cream and topped with a fresh blackberry. Can also be made with the cream layer on top for a lighter look. The bold grape flavor and rich creamy base create a soft, refreshing bite that feels classic and elegant. Perfect for parties, showers, baptisms, birthdays, and any celebration that calls for a beautiful dessert table.

name: Heart Flan Mini with Vanilla Cake
description: Heart-shaped individual vanilla cake topped with silky flan and caramel, finished with chantilly cream, a cherry, and a caramel heart.
longDescription: A personal-sized heart-shaped dessert featuring a soft, moist vanilla cake base topped with a silky, slow-baked flan and a glossy caramel finish. Each one is decorated with a swirl of chantilly cream, a maraschino cherry, and a handmade caramel heart. Romantic, elegant, and perfect for Valentine's Day, anniversaries, bridal showers, weddings, and any celebration that deserves a little extra love. Custom toppers available on request, just let us know your theme when ordering.

name: Flan Mini with Vanilla Cake & Caramel Pipette
description: Individual vanilla cake topped with silky flan, finished with chantilly cream, a cherry, and a caramel-filled pipette for extra drizzle.
longDescription: A personal-sized two-layer dessert featuring a soft vanilla cake base topped with a silky, slow-baked flan and a glossy caramel finish. Each one is decorated with a swirl of chantilly cream and a maraschino cherry, plus a caramel-filled pipette so you can add an extra drizzle of caramel right before eating. Fun, interactive, and delicious. Perfect for birthdays, parties, showers, and dessert tables. Custom toppers available on request, just let us know your theme when ordering.

name: Choco Flan Cake with Strawberries & Dulce de Leche
description: Full-size chocolate cake topped with silky flan, drizzled with dulce de leche and chocolate, crowned with fresh strawberries and gold flakes.
longDescription: Our signature full-size choco flan: a moist chocolate cake base topped with a creamy, slow-baked flan. Each cake is finished with drizzles of dulce de leche and chocolate, a center of glazed fresh strawberries, and edible gold flakes for an elegant touch. A showstopper for birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and family gatherings. Custom decorations available on request, just let us know your theme when ordering.

name: Gelatina Tricolor Mexicana
description: Individual three-layer gelatinas in green, white, and red, topped with whipped cream and a Mexican flag pick.
longDescription: Celebrate in style with our tricolor gelatinas, inspired by the colors of the Mexican flag. Each individual gelatina features a green layer, a creamy white layer, and a bright red layer, finished with a swirl of whipped cream and a Mexican flag topper. Perfect for Fiestas Patrias, Independence Day (16 de Septiembre), Cinco de Mayo, and any celebration of Mexican pride. Custom toppers available on request.
